Gross profit fell 20.9% to EUR 20.7 million, reducing the gross margin from 12.6% to 10.3%.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure: it begins with an overview of weakened financial performance (S1), details revenue and passenger declines (S2), identifies causes (S3), breaks down revenue categories (S4), discusses profitability metrics (S5-S13), notes year-end improvements (S14-S17), addresses financial flexibility concerns (S18-S20), and concludes with post-year actions and outlook (S21-S22). The only notable issue is minor repetition in S4 and S5 where revenue and profit declines are discussed consecutively without significant new information. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or severe organizational problems. The arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the candidate does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
